title: Learn the Latest About X-59 and its Mission - March 2023
description: The X-59 research aircraft is the centerpiece of NASA's Quesst mission. It is designed to fly supersonic without creating a loud sonic boom to people on the ground. In this edition of Inside the Quesst see the latest assembly update, life support system research, and recent STEM news.
